class.name: SteamHttpResponse
class.brief_description: Owned metadata and bytes for a complete HTTP response.
class.description: A complete HTTP response can carry an unsuccessful HTTP status. The enclosing [SteamHttpResponseResult] reports transport and completion errors.

method.name: get_status
method.description: Return the final HTTP status code.

method.name: get_body
method.description: Return the bounded response bytes. HEAD responses have an empty body.

method.name: header
method.description: Return a captured response header by case-insensitive name. An absent, empty, or unselected field returns an empty string.

method.name: json
method.description: Parse the body as UTF-8 JSON and return its separate decoding result. Check the parsing outcome independently of the response status.

method.name: is_successful
method.description: Return true when the HTTP status is in the 2xx range.
